Description
Enjoying the spacious open kitchen/dining/living areas, The den is perfect for an office, in-suite storage/pantry room, two bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The home exquisitely finished with Hardwood flooring in all living areas, carpets in both bedrooms, double edged granite to stainless steel appliances. Floor to ceiling glass walls celebrate the natural environment. Features include 24 hour concierge, over-height ceilings, granite & corian countertops, Family size appliances, AC , custom crafted wood cabinets & quality finishing throughout. As a resident at Waterford, you get to enjoy membership at Club Viva, a resort-style facility that includes lap pool, theatre, spa, squash courts and much more. Minutes walking distance to Yaletown Roundhouse station.
